steps: Traffic spikes, and three tickets hit TicketFlow at once: a double charge, a crash, and a dark mode request.
The synchronous Flask service sends ticket one, and blocks the event loop while it waits for the reply.
Reply one finally returns, but tickets two and three sat waiting the whole time, and their requests time out.
So you switch the client to Async Anthropic. Now every call is awaitable, and waiting on one reply no longer blocks the others.
Next, asyncio gather fires all three calls at once. The event loop never blocks, and three requests are in flight together.
At peak traffic, Claude throws a four twenty-nine rate limit. The S D K retries automatically with backoff, here with three max retries and a thirty second timeout, so no manual loop is needed.
Finally, all three results land together: billing, technical, and feature request. No timeouts, and the latency is roughly one call, not three.
